title: crepis aurea subsp. lucida
intro: Crepis aurea subsp. lucida, commonly known as gold-scaled hawk's beard, is a flowering plant species within the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits such as soothing the stomach and reducing fever. The plant is reported to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. Bioactive constituents found in Crepis aurea subsp. lucida include sesquiterpene lactones and other compounds that may be responsible for its therapeutic effects.
